Moderate on sluggish ships with hardpoints/front shields; low on frigates and fast destroyers.

Hybrid-mount weapons x2, minimum +100, not in JAOModel.range().
Low combat value per OP: half the hull of Reinforced Bulkheads for ~80% of its OP. Filler.

ECCM Package: ECCM chance 50% (s-mod 100%), missile guidance +1, missile speed +25%, acceleration +150%, turn rate +50%, turn acceleration +150%, EW range penalty x0.5 (s-mod x0). Fleet support. Low per-ship value; 6/12/18/24 OP is expensive. Only worth it when building an ECM fleet or with spare OP.

Escort Package: within 700 su of a larger friendly ship (fading to 1200): ballistic and energy range +20%, top speed +10%, maneuverability +25%; doubled for a destroyer next to a capital (advanceInCombat, unread). Niche: ships with charge-based energy weapons or ammo-limited ballistics. Better as S-mod (+50% regen).

No value on non-flagships. Only consider when fitting the flagship and CP matter.

No stats. Any hull. 3/6/12/24 OP.

Emergency Recall Device: once per battle a lethal hull hit leaves 1 HP; the ship turns invulnerable, warps to the nearest carrier and comes back at 50% hull. Costs CR equal to its deployment cost (HullDamageAboutToBeTakenListener). No stats. Strikecraft only; refuses Phase Anchor. 8/15/30/24 OP.

DP + ceil(wing OP / 5) only when built in. 10/10/15/20 OP.

OVERLORD SUITE [BETA]: consumes a beta core. Uncrewed fighters launched by this ship get the beta core officer as captain (applyEffectsToFighterSpawnedByShip). No stats. Shown only with the core in cargo. Hulls with bays or bayless strikecraft. 0 OP.

OVERLORD SUITE [GAMMA]: consumes a gamma core. Uncrewed fighters launched by this ship get the gamma core officer as captain (applyEffectsToFighterSpawnedByShip). No stats. Shown only with the core in cargo. Hulls with bays or bayless strikecraft. 0 OP.

Defensive Design (hidden, Euphonium, Flute, Invictus (DPL)): after creation, base range above 700 su loses 80% of the overage (WeaponBaseRangeModifier), and if any large non-PD weapon is fitted a DamageDealtModifier multiplies all damage the ship deals by 0.1. S-mod: energy damage +5% (stats). See Breaks.

Phase Coil Extension (15/20/25/35 OP, phase hulls only, no_build_in): dpl_ExtendedCoils raises the dynamic stat phase_cloak_flux_level_for_min_speed_mod by 100%, which doubles the flux level at which phased top speed bottoms out. AO does not read it. No s-mod effect.
Phase Hangar (hidden; no hull in the dump carries it): fighter refit time x0.5 while phased (x0.333 with Phase Anchor).
Phase Integration (hidden, Vengeance, Vibraphone): phase cooldown -90%, activation cost x0; while phased, dissipation, weapon rate of fire and ammo regen x2 (listener).
Phase Projection (hidden, Vengeance): at lethal damage the ship returns to full hull and zero flux after a delay (resurrection).
Plasma Coupling (hidden; Gunnery Modules, Olympias modules, Lion Anthem-class stations): a DamageDealtModifier sets forceHardFlux on beam damage. Rule beams_hard covers it.
Special Armor (5/10/15/25 OP): top speed +25/20/15/15 su by hull size; armor x0.8; shield damage taken x1.2 (stats, read); known only after its quest
Temporal Targeting System (0/0/25/35 OP): ballistic and energy range +15%, PD range -5% more (stats, read). Frigate and destroyer cost is 0 OP in hull_mods.csv. Known only after the Phase Lab quest.

Weapon Overcharge (10/15/20/30 OP): hull x0.8, armor x0.8, shield damage taken x1.2 (stats, read); all damage dealt x1.1 through a DamageDealtModifier (combat rule DMG_BEM 1.1); known only after its quest

Plasma Aggregator: all effects are in advanceInCombat, so AO's stats see nothing. Synergy weapons (mount override SYNERGY, 12 in the mod) cool down 1.4x as fast (plain beams excluded; charge-up and burst delays unchanged, so x1.17 to x1.38 peak rate by weapon, x1.00 for na_pyrowisp). Every weapon in a synergy slot and every synergy weapon gets 20% of one shot's flux refunded per fire sequence (soft flux only); non-burst beams get 20% of their flux cost a second added to dissipation while firing. S-mod: reload progress +30% on energy and synergy weapons, no penalty. Built into Tessera and Macula and their Stargazer versions. 3/6/9/15 OP. No existing rule kind selects synergy weapons or slots (hm.md Code needed)

Superconducting Conduits: advanceInCombat only. Missile and synergy weapons cool down and regain ammo (1 + r) times as fast with r = 0.6 / (1 + p); p = 2 x min(1, (OP of missile and synergy weapons - T) / (2 x T)), T = 10/20/40/80 OP by hull size (20/40/80/160 as s-mod). r is 0.6 up to T, 0.3 at 2T, 0.2 from 3T. S-mod doubles T, no penalty. Row ROF_MIS:1.25 in hm-rules.csv (judgment). 3/6/9/15 OP

Armor Energizer Matrix: stats: flux dissipation -5% unless s-modded (AO reads it and scores a pure penalty). advanceInCombat: hard flux gained is stored 1:1 as energy (max 1000/2500/5000/10000), decays 10 a second with the shield off and the ship not phased, and loses 0.7 per point of hull or armor damage taken. At energy E: effective armor +max x sqrt(E / Emax) (max 300/450/600/800) and hull, weapon and engine damage taken -50% x sqrt(E / Emax). Needs a shield or phase cloak. Removes Shield Shunt. S-mod removes the dissipation penalty. 4/8/12/20 OP. Combat rows in hm-rules.csv (judgment)

incompatible: na_stargazerhullmod fragment_swarm secondary_fabricator fragment_coordinator shrouded_lens shrouded_mantle shrouded_thunderhead
note: Stardust Nebula: takes a Stardust Core (special item na_stardust_core) on install. Makes a mote swarm of 15/30/45/60 (regrows 0.5/1/1.5/3 a second) that powers Stargazer weapons and the four Stargazer add-ons; no value without them. S-mod: max CR -20% (penalty). Not applicable with the Stargazer hull hullmod, Fragment Swarm, Secondary Fabricator, Fragment Coordinator or any Shrouded hullmod. Removes Fragment Swarm after ship creation. 6/12/18/30 OP

Rage-Fueled Machine: needs a swarm and a Stardust Core. Mote regrowth +30% x flux level and +30% x missing hull (full at 30% hull left); s-mod: mote cap up to +60% at 30% hull. Only changes how fast stardust weapons refill; AO never tries it. 4/8/12/20 OP

Cosmic Shunt: needs a swarm and a Stardust Core. advanceInCombat adds 4 flux dissipation per live mote: 60/120/180/240 at a full swarm of 15/30/45/60. S-mod: mote cap +50%. Rows VENT_FLAT in hm-rules.csv at 80% of a full swarm (judgment). 4/8/12/20 OP

Dream Eater: needs a swarm and a Stardust Core. Heals 10 hull points for each mote the swarm loses (spent by stardust weapons or destroyed); s-mod: heal x(1 + min(1, flux level / 0.9)). The motes lost in a fight depend on the weapons fitted and the enemy, so it is not priced from the fit. 4/8/12/20 OP

Soul Stealer: needs a swarm and a Stardust Core. Energy and missile damage +1% per 1/2/4/8 live motes (frigate to capital), cap 30%: 15/15/11.25/7.5% at a full swarm. A non-fighter enemy killed by a ship with a swarm adds 20 motes per size class and moves the victim's motes over. No s-mod effect. Rows DMG_ENE and DMG_MIS at 70% of a full swarm (judgment). 5/10/15/25 OP

Tidal Grid (hidden; built into Ister, Xanthe and the Macula, Mare and Sop protos): needs a phase cloak (advanceInCombat calls getPhaseCloak() every frame). Stats: phase min-speed flux threshold +300%, phase time bonus mult +0.7%. Tidal Burst arms after 3/2.6/2.3/2 s in phase and then lasts 1.2 s per second phased (max 15 s): ballistic flux -50% and rate of fire +50%, energy flux -33% and damage +33%, missile damage +33% and HP +50%. S-mod: vent rate +20%. Removes Adaptive Phase Coils. Rows in hm-rules.csv (judgment)

Hardlight Matrix (hidden; built into Losulci): per live hardlight_generator module whose weapon works and while the ship neither overloads nor vents: effective armor +50/100/150/250/350 (fighter to capital) and hull and armor damage taken -10%. Losulci has two generators: +700 armor and x0.8. Removes Omni Shield Conversion and Extended Shields. Rows in hm-rules.csv (judgment)

Aegis Deflectors (hidden; built into Stargazer Losulci): per live hardlight_generator module, shield absorption mult x(1 - 0.45 x modules) while the ship neither overloads nor vents: two modules give x0.10 flux per shield damage. Also multiplies hard flux dissipation fraction by 0 (base value is 0, so no change). Removes Omni Shield Conversion and Extended Shields. Row TAKEN_SHIELD in hm-rules.csv (judgment)

Metallic Aggregate - Diamond Back: dissipation x0.40, speed and maneuver x0.85, armor +20%, armor reduction cap +0.15, energy damage taken x1.25, other types x0.85, mass x2; the hull spec becomes a phase-type shield with no shield (system cs_diamondBack: hull, armor and EMP damage taken x0.33 for 8 s of 24 s). Needs a Metallic Aggregate item; cannot be removed. Combat rows in jao_rules.
Planula: 15 hull points restored on every hull or armor hit above 1 damage (beams 15 a second of contact). Needs a Planula item. hull_regen row in jao_rules (0.5% of hull a second, judgment).

Pocket I.C.B.M.: every fired missile is copied twice (random point within 20 su, +-20 degrees), missile damage x0.67 set after ship creation, so 2.0 damage per missile of ammo. Needs a Pocket I.C.B.M. item. combat DMG_MIS row in jao_rules.

Transcendence: host hull set to 1; a shield drone with flux capacity max hull + 10 x armor rating absorbs all damage; at overload the host takes armor damage x100. Needs a Transcendence item. Cannot be modeled; never_add.

Inertia Negator: max speed +max(35, 50% of base), acceleration, deceleration and turn acceleration +10000, max turn rate +min(speed bonus, 60), burn +4, engine damage taken x2, malfunction x1.5; negative speed modifiers are removed in combat (not seen). Needs an Inertia Negator Node item; cannot be removed.
Terraprisma: 8 blades, a pass every 13.5 s each, 600 energy per enemy crossed (minimum 300). Modeled by jao_hullmod_damage. Needs a Terra fragment item.

Lobster Control Node: puts a level 1 Hench-Lobster officer on a ship with no captain; s-mod makes the ship Reckless and ignoring orders. Needs a Bad Tempered Lobster item. Campaign and officer effect; combat value comes from the officer.
Erratic Fighter Forge: launched fighters are replaced by random fighters from 14 whitelisted mods. Random wing value; needs an Erratic Fighter Forge item.
Conversion: clears all fitted weapons, clones the hull spec for Conquest, Pegasus, Champion and Mudskipper2; needs a Dubious Disc; cannot be removed.
Onslaught Core Conversion: puts a Slaught core captain on a capital Onslaught with no captain; needs a Slaught Core item.

Choir: acts only as an s-mod; clones the hull spec with an omni shield (arc 210) and system sotf_concordshift, adds sotf_sierrasconcord and phasefield. Non-Sierra captains get system uses -1 and regen x0.67. Never added.

Integrated Automation Interchange: switches a hull between automated and crewed through a spec clone and an OP-penalty hullmod (cs_aiswitch_penalty); needs an Alpha Core item; presses the R key while the refit tab is open. Never added.
AM Charge Microforge: campaign ability and cargo x0.5; needs an Antimatter Microforge item and 1200 cargo.
Jump Stabilizer: transverse jump fuel x0; s-mod: burn +1, zero-flux speed boost +20 (stat), engines repaired once per battle. Logistics.

Splintering Fragments: Threat hulls with fragment_swarm; fragment respawn x0, unlimited swarm size, 1 fragment per 25/30/35/40 hull or armor damage taken, fragment weapon damage x1.2. Built in on cs_hound_threat and cs_vanguard_threat.
Bolstering Fragments: swarm size +50%; each fragment is a 150 hp, 15 armor blocker (+2% of the host's armor as s-mod or built in). Needs fragment_swarm.
Phase Shunt: removes the phase cloak (shield type NONE), armor +15%, s-mod 10% chance to ignore hull damage. Experimental; never added.
Makeshift Phase Cloak: adds a phase cloak to a non-phase ship (flux capacity and dissipation x0.90; activation 8% and upkeep 5% of capacity); s-mod costs x0.85. Experimental; never added.
System Swap: opens a dialog in the refit tab and replaces the ship system. Experimental; never added.
Module Propagator: copies the parent's hullmods onto 0 OP modules. Experimental; never added.
Vambrace Duct Tape: replaces the member's variant, adds 2 armor modules (15000 hull, 1100 armor each) to Onslaught-like capitals, sets CR to 0, cannot be removed. Never added.
Flextrous Turrets: every non-built-in turret arc x1.5 through a spec clone. Experimental; AO reads no arc.
Superficial Surfacing: s-mod raises hull base value x1.35 and hides d-mod overlays. No combat effect.
Cramped Internals (Gavel): missile slot OP below 8 gives dissipation +5% per OP (up to +40%), above 8 system regen -5% per OP; applied after ship creation, so AO's stats miss it.
Charge Accumulator (Arc-en-ciel): weapon in COAXSLOT gets damage x1.5, ammo x1.5, never disabled, plus homing, EMP arcs or retaliation arcs by type.
The Mega Hound (Fenrir): HANGARSLOT weapon is copied to 6 pods; the hound inherits the parent's captain and hullmods with a frigate cost.
Flux Inverter (Wake): shield damage taken x-1, dissipation x0, energy flux cost x(1 - 0.5 x flux level). The stats read negative shield damage and 0 dissipation; the ship is not scored.
Start Your Engines (super d-mod): engine flames x3 length deal HE; beam bonus from flame length. Added by the Deconstruction skill; positive.
Smart Shells (super d-mod): projectile speed x1.33 (stat), +15% projectile weapon range and random homing (not seen). Positive.
Flux Loop (super d-mod): overload cancelled, 1% max hull HE per second of overload, stacking +10% dissipation.
Ad-hoc Missile Blend (super d-mod): missile ammo +25% and +2/4/8, guidance +1 (stats); random replacement of launched missiles and self-firing (not seen).
Bursting Phase Coils (super d-mod): EMP arcs on unphasing, 20% chance for x0.20 hull and armor damage.
Out-of-tune Phase Coils (super d-mod): hull damage taken x0 and ignored by enemies while fully phased.
Drifting P-position (super d-mod): flux-scaled chance to reappear elsewhere on unphasing.
Rampant Fighter Nanoforge (super d-mod): 50% of launched fighters replaced at random.
Faulty IFF Codes (super d-mod): fighters may land on enemy carriers and deal HE equal to their max hull.
Extremely Unstable Shield Emitter (super d-mod): shield damage taken x1.2 (stat), projectiles reflected at 0.5 x damage.
Hotwired Systems Bypass (super d-mod): system regen +60%, cooldown x0.60 (stats); the ship system is used whenever it can be (not seen).

Point Defense Specialization (built in: Collie, Beauceron, Retriever, Dalmatian, Wurgandal Defense Module): OnlyPDHullmodCostListener (WeaponOPCostModifier) makes every weapon whose role string lacks Point Defense, Anti Fighter and Anti Small Craft, and whose hints lack PD and ANTI_FTR, cost 99999 OP. AO prices on the scratch member (JAOShip.op) so only PD weapons fit. Stats: PD beam, ballistic and missile weapon range +100 flat, weapon turn rate x1.35.

Small Drone Hangar (built in on 18 hulls): OnlyDronesHullmodCostListener (FighterOPCostModifier) makes every wing without the auto_fighter or drone tag, or costing over 12 OP, cost 99999 OP. The five ED drone wings (3 to 12 OP) fit. AO prices wings on the scratch member (JAOShip.op) so no bay rule is needed.

Safety Removal (built in: Leonberger, Saluki, Saluki-X, Chupacabra, Wolfhound Mk.II): max speed +30 flat on every size, zero-flux minimum flux level +2 (the boost stays on), weapon range past 450 x0.25 (WeaponRangeThreshold 450, WeaponRangeMultPastThreshold 0.25), max turn rate, turn acceleration, acceleration and deceleration x1.2, crew salary x1.2. No dissipation or peak time change. Removes Safety Overrides after ship creation. AO reads speed, acceleration and the range threshold; it misses the zero-flux boost, as with safetyoverrides.

Ancient Phase Coils (Saluki-X built in; isApplicableToShip needs a phase hull with it as a built-in mod): phase_cloak_flux_level_for_min_speed_mod +50% (+75% s-modded; minus 50 points when Adaptive Phase Coils is on the ship), phase upkeep x0.9 (x0.8 s-modded), phase_cloak_speed +10 (+20), phase cooldown x0.5, crew salary x1.5. applyEffectsAfterShipCreation removes Adaptive Phase Coils unless it is an s-mod. AO reads the upkeep through phaseCost; the threshold, speed and cooldown are dynamic stats it does not read. No s-mod penalty.

Multicore Ballistic Integration (built in: Beagle, Dobermann, Dobermann shield module): ballistic weapon range x(1 + 0.7 capital, 0.5 cruiser, 0.3 destroyer, 0.2 frigate) by the parent station's hull size (ModuleRange.getRangeMulti, re-applied each frame in advanceInCombat); removes Integrated Targeting Unit, Advanced Optics, Dampened Mounts Package and Dedicated Targeting Core after creation. AO reads the module hull's own size (+20%) where the game applies +30% (Beagle modules) or +70% (Dobermann modules). Grand Salvo damage is carried by edshipyard_module_range in jao_hullmod_damage.

Weapons Integration (built in: Wurgandal weapon modules, Chupacabra, Saluki-X): weapon OP cost -4 large, -2 medium, -1 small for every weapon type (dynamic stats large_ballistic_mod to small_missile_mod); affectsOPCosts TRUE. AO prices on the scratch member, so the savings reach the OP budget.

Field Shield Generator (built in: Retriever): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation removes every non-built-in hullmod tagged shields or reqShields (d-mods kept) and swp_shieldbypass. The Retriever has a PHASE shield type and no phase cloak; its shield is the Retriever Shield module (front 360 degrees, efficiency 0.25, 10000 flux capacity, 2000 dissipation). System edshipyard_field_shield_control toggles that shield and adds the module's hard flux to the parent's flux times (1 + accumulated hard flux / 20000). AO sees a hull with no shield.
Shield Incompatible (built in: Wurgandal modules, Cargo Wagons, Riptide): removes Makeshift Shield Generator (frontshield) after ship creation. No stats.
Frontal Locked Shields (built in: Wurgandal jaw modules): removes Shield Conversion - Omni (adaptiveshields) after ship creation. No stats.
Hangar Incompatible (built in: Wurgandal jaw and weapon modules, Retriever Shield): removes Converted Hangar after ship creation. No stats.

Sinuous Structure (built in: Newfoundland, Helltrain): zero-flux speed boost x0.3, sensor profile +150, adds the wagons' cargo, fuel, crew and supplies (+4 supplies a wagon); advanceInCombat steers the 5 wagon modules, relays target and vent commands and pushes friendly ships out of 110 su of a wagon (30 to 150 su/s, acceleration 600).

Wurgandal Module (built in: the 7 Wurgandal modules): every 0.15 s moves 100 flux from the module to the parent while the parent is under 5000 flux, copies parent overload, vent, target, shield and fighter orders. Boss ship, no player slots.
Massive Hull (Wurgandal): sensor strength +150, sensor profile +60, supplies a month x1.5, recovery +1000, break probability x0. Campaign stats.
Tyrant Maw Bombardment (Wurgandal): ground support +400, fleet bombard cost reduction +8000. Campaign only.
Expanded Explosion (Basenji, Bernard): hull explosion damage x2, radius x3 on death. No effect on a fit.

Fleet Repair Optimizations (Retriever): while the Retriever is in the player fleet, FleetRepairOptimizationsBonusScript (every 10 s) adds the permanent hullmod edshipyard_fleet_repair_optimizations_bonus to every fleet member (repair rate +25%, base CR recovery +25%) and removes it when no ship carries this hullmod. Campaign only.

Fleet Repair Bonus (hidden permanent mod): added and removed by FleetRepairOptimizationsBonusScript on every player fleet member; repair rate +25%, base CR recovery +25%. AO must neither add nor strip it (rules never_add and never_remove).
Greater Drive Field Stabilizer (Bernard): fleet burn +2, sensor profile +200. Campaign only.

Illusion Field (built in: Chihuahua, Shiba): sensor profile x0; advanceInCombat teleports each live doppel drone that is within the ship's radius + 100 to 3 to 5 radii away and sets its hull damage taken x0.01. The doppels' own weapons: Chihuahua 3 doppels with Plink (5 dps each), Shiba 2 doppels with Nanocloud Caster Fake (44 dps each, no flux cost). Not modelled.
Rescue Drone (Beauceron, Retriever): dummy hullmod (isApplicableToShip false) that explains the Rescue Drone control module (edshipyard_spatial_swap on a fighter hull). No stats.

Detonator Drone (Beauceron Mk.II, Retriever Mk.II): dummy hullmod that stands for the detonator control modules (1 and 2). Each module launches one detonator drone, regenerated at 0.015 a second; the drone's Self Destruct (7 s charge-up) explodes for 2500 HE at the core (200 su), 500 at 400 su. Carried by jao_hullmod_damage.

Damper Defense System (built in: Lector): weapon health and engine health +200%, weapon and engine repair time +100% (slower); applyEffectsAfterShipCreation removes frontshield, frontemitter, adaptiveshields, stabilizedshieldemitter, hardenedshieldemitter, advancedshieldemitter and extendedshieldemitter and shows LE_IncompatibleHullmodWarning for 3 frames. The hull has a PHASE shield type with the vanilla damper defense, so it has no shield.

Bombardment of Divine Wrath (built in: Prometheus Mk. IV): fleet ground support +250 (campaign). Firing le_dram_w costs 30% CR (x1/0.8 per d-mod) and needs that much CR. Removes Efficiency Overhaul after ship creation and shows LE_IncompatibleHullmodWarning for 3 frames.

Converted Cargo Bay (built in: Phaeton (LP)): applyEffectsToFighterSpawnedByShip runs vanilla DefectiveManufactory on each fighter: max speed x0.75, armor, shield and hull damage taken +25%. Rule wing_mult 0.88, the value of defective_manufactory.
Insulated Fire Control (hidden; no hull, skin or variant in either mod uses it): weapon damage taken x0.5, EMP damage taken x0.5.
HULLMOD CONFLICT (hidden helper): added by luddenhance_shieldblock and luddenhance_bombardment for 3 frames after they remove a hullmod. No stats. AO must neither add nor remove it.
Improvised Explosive Ship (built in: the 3 IED hulls): individual ship recovery x0, so the ship is never recovered. No combat stats.

External Missile Racks (built into jdp_plunder): missile ammo +100% (read); missile rate of fire modifyPercent(0.8), which is +0.8% (the description says -20%; read, negligible); advanceInCombat: when a child module (the cargo pods) dies, every missile weapon's ammo x0.5 and weapon.disable() (not read; combat rule in jdp-rules.csv)
Maintenance Nanite Tanks (built into jdp_shoebill): engine and weapon repair time x0 (modifyMult 1 - 1.0; not read, so AO scores 0 for it), overload time x0.5 (read)

Heavy Energy Integration (built into jdp_supremator, jdp_drover_lg): large energy weapons cost 10 OP less (LARGE_ENERGY_MOD -10; computeOPCost counts it); weapon malfunction chance +0.0025 and critical engine malfunction chance +0.00025 (read)

Dumb-fire Conversion (built into jdp_lupara): missile damage +15%, speed and acceleration +30%, hit points +5% (read); missile turn rate and turn acceleration -100% (not read: guided missiles fly straight; see Code needed in jdp.md)
Antimatter-Fusion Plant (built into jdp_cydonia): overload time x0.75 (read); fleet burn +3 and sensor profile of at least 300 (campaign)

Magnetic Accelerator (built into jdp_arcubus): a WeaponRangeModifier listener adds +100% range to weapons in LARGE BALLISTIC HARDPOINT slots (not read: AO shows base range); applyEffectsAfterShipCreation clones the projectile spec of those weapons: speed x2 and collision class set to the fighter variant; the affected slots are WS 005, WS 013 and WS 016
Sixth Battlegroup (built into jdp_falcon_vi, jdp_pegasus_vi): speed, acceleration, deceleration, turn rate and turn acceleration x1.1, armor x0.95, flux capacity and dissipation x1.05 (read)

Scwarzsech Hide (built into jdp_chuuni): advanceInCombat repairs 20 armor a second (RATE) over the damaged cells and removes the same amount of hard flux (it repairs only while hard flux stays above 0); after repairs exceed 5 x armor rating (THRESHOLD, 4500 on 900 armor) the rate falls as 4500 / total; not read; combat rule in jdp-rules.csv
Audacious Livery! (built into jdp_buffalo_pmmm): cosmetic, no stat

Frictionless Hull (built into jdp_laplacian): ship time x2 (TIMEFLOW_BONUS 1; read as timeMult: dissipation, speed and rate of fire x2), effective armor and minimum armor fraction x0.6 (read), supplies a month x2 and peak CR time x0.5 (read as peak time); advanceInCombat slows the global clock by 1/2 while the player flies the ship
Cloaking Field (built into jdp_laplacian): the vanilla PhaseField script on a phase hull; no mod code
Boarding Nets (built into jdp_florencia, jdp_florencia_hegemony): fleet ground support +50 (campaign raids)

Maerulan Phase Coils (built into jdp_marlin, jdp_manjusaka): phase cloak cooldown x0.2 (getPhaseCloakCooldownBonus modifyMult 1 - 0.8) and the hard flux level at which phase speed falls +100% (PHASE_CLOAK_FLUX_LEVEL_FOR_MIN_SPEED_MOD); phase cooldown is not read

Mobile Minefield (built into jdp_shoebill): advanceInCombat every 0.5-1.5 s picks each enemy ship with 25% chance and drops a vanilla minelayer1 mine (2000 HE, proximity 175, core 200, radius 250, 20 s life) 400-800 su beyond its hull, 1 to 7 a pick; the explosion also hits friendly ships (MISSILE_FF); no damage row (hit rate unknown)
Banisher Core (built into jdp_thunderer): damage to fighters +100%, to destroyers +100%, to cruisers and capitals x0.25 (read: sizeDmg, fighterDmg)
Ancient Testbed (built into jdp_deshret): ballistic weapon flux cost +50%, energy weapon flux cost +100%, fighter refit time +30% (read)
Missile Speedloader (built into jdp_pegasus_vi): missile rate of fire +200%, missile ammo x0.5 (read; the launcher rate cap in the pool applies)

Erroneous Ordinance (built into jdp_plunder, jdp_grendel_lp; tagged dmod): crew losses +25%, combat repair time +10%, ship explosion damage and radius x3; DModManager counts it as a d-mod, so AO's d-mod repair can list it (see Breaks in jdp.md)

Throughdeck Bays (built into jdp_conduit): fighter refit time x0.1 unless Converted Hangar is installed (then no bonus); FORCE_ALLOW_CONVERTED_HANGAR lets Converted Hangar go on a ship that has bays (read as refit time)
Fusion Burn (built into jdp_lamp, the Erratic Fusion Lamp colony item): pulsar visual and burn damage to ships in the beam (solar shielding halves it); the lamp is not a fleet ship

Mirror Shield (built into jdp_penrose): a DamageTakenModifier reflects projectiles, missiles (re-targeted to the source) and beams that hit the shield at full damage; shield arc capped at 45 each frame; reflection is not read; the hull's own shield arc is 45
True Demon (hidden everywhere, tier 0): DP -30 and peak CR time x999; on the jdp_laplacian TrueDemon variant through variant data; no hull has it built in

Mercenary Relay Helper (hidden everywhere; added by the skill With The Network of second_in_command, which is not enabled): swaps the variant's hull spec for a clone with +1 fighter bay and a built-in jdp_relay wing while the fleet commander has the tag jdp_flowerfishWithTheNetwork; inactive in this install
Increased Explosion (hidden everywhere; built into jdp_plunder_cargo): ship explosion damage and radius x10

Emulated Frictionless Hull (15/25/35/45 OP by hull size; tag no_build_in, so not an s-mod; takes one item jdp_frictionlessmetal a ship, getRequiredItem): ship time x1.40 frigate, x1.35 destroyer, x1.30 cruiser, x1.25 capital (TIME map; read as timeMult), effective armor and minimum armor fraction x0.6, supplies a month x2, peak CR time x0.5; not on phase hulls; advanceInCombat slows the global clock by 1/time while the player flies it; AO's item counting (HullModItemManager) covers the item

Mercenary Relay (10 OP, cruisers only, tag no_build_in): sight radius +2000 (getSightRadiusMod, campaign vision); the relay-drone bonuses need the skill With The Network of second_in_command (not enabled); not on station modules, jdp_modularShip, converted hangars
Ground Support Fighters (hidden; tag on jdp_manjusaka_wing): fleet ground support +30 per such wing in the variant (campaign raids)
Modular Ship (hidden everywhere; on the Penrose modules): no effect, blocks installing some hullmods

Linked Engines (hidden everywhere; on the Penrose engine modules and shard): advanceInCombat copies the parent's accelerate, decelerate and strafe commands to the module and mirrors flame and burn glow; no stat
Timid (hidden everywhere; Logistics tag): personality marker; no stat; isApplicableToShip fails while another personality mod is on the variant
Cautious (hidden everywhere): personality marker as Timid; no stat
Aggressive (hidden everywhere): personality marker as Timid; no stat
Reckless (hidden everywhere): personality marker as Timid; no stat

Gethsemane Rescue Bay (hidden; built into invictus_kh): fighter crew loss x0.2 (Stats.FIGHTER_CREW_LOSS_MULT, campaign) and GethsemaneListener returns 80% of the crew lost in a player engagement; no combat stat

Converted Missile Holds: cargo x0.1; missile ammo +min(25% of hull cargo, 100)% from a map filled after ship creation, so AO reads 0 or the last ship's value; frigate 5%, destroyer 19%, cruiser 35%, capital 68% on average; never_add. 5/15/30/60 OP. no_build_in.

Safety Protocols: peak CR time +100%, speed -25/-20/-15/-10 flat, dissipation x0.75, missile RoF x0.75, malfunction x0.7. Not on capitals or civgrade. Removes Safety Overrides. 10/20/30/40 OP. no_build_in.
Quantum Damper: while overloaded at or below 0.75 hard flux level, hull and armor damage x0.25, EMP x0.15; s-mod overload time x0.75 and EMP x0.75; AO sees none of it. 2/4/6/8 OP.
Repulse-Field: pushes enemy ships and missiles within up to 600 su by a small force that scales with flux (ship max 4, missile max 2); no damage. 4/12/25/40 OP. no_build_in.

Guerrilla Overhaul: peak CR time x0, CR per deployment x0, CR loss x0.35-0.5, malfunction x0.5; the stat lines return early for a scratch member, so AO sees nothing. Under 2% CR over 90 s. 2/4/6/8 OP. no_build_in.

Elipsion mode (hidden): system fortressshield7s, shield arc +180, unfold x1.5, ballistic and energy range x1.15, PD range -10%, peak CR time +60 s. Added by aswitcher_elipsion; the mode changes each battle.

Pristine Condition (hidden, Stella Tempestas7s Experimental): energy flux x0.5, ship time x1.25, missile ammo x25, omni shield 300 arc, in advanceInCombat. combat rows carry them.

Passive Venting Hack: flux capacity x0.5, vent rate 0, zero-flux boost 0 (read); dissipation x2 x non-zero vent mods is set in advanceInCombat (combat row DISS 2). Not on shielded or phase ships. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Hardflux Shielding Coils: hard flux dissipation x0 and EMP taken modified by +hard flux in points (flat on a multiplier); phase upkeep +100% per point of hard flux. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Phase-Stasis Coils A: phase time normalized to 1.0x, flux speed penalty removed; AO has no timeflow term. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Phase-Stasis Coils B: upkeep x0.5 (AO reads it as +9.5% phase EHP) with phase time normalized to 1.0x, which AO does not count. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Phase-Stasis Coils C: time normalized and 50% of it diverted to ammo regen, dissipation, repair. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Phase-Stasis Coils O: like A with 50% of the time diverted, clamped to 1.0 or more. Built in on khe_tesseract. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Buttercup Time Reactor: peak CR time x1.333; ship time x2/3 and hull, armor and shield damage taken x2/3 (s-mod x1/3 for both). combat rows TIME 0.667 and TAKEN_ALL 0.667; never_smod. 2/4/6/10 OP.
Phase-Warped Anchor: automated phase ships only; cloak activation x0; emergency dive costs 2 x deployment CR and retreats the ship. 10/20/30/50 OP.
AI Core Fighter Uplink: automated ships with bays; DP +20%; each fighter gets a copy of the core captain. wing_mult 1.10. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Fighter Defense Extender: phase fighters cloak flux x0.5; shielded fighters arc x2; others hull, armor, EMP damage x2/3. wing_mult 1.12. 5/10/15/20 OP.

Harmonic Weapon Integration: energy weapons; same as the ballistic one. never_add, never_remove. 0 OP.
Harmonic Weapon Integration: missile weapons; same, and each missile weapon cuts dissipation. never_add, never_remove. 0 OP.
Artillery Module: large ballistic weapons +20 OP each and +1000 range (listener, after creation). never_add, never_remove. 0 OP.
Artillery Module: large energy weapons +20 OP and +1000 range. never_add, never_remove. 0 OP.
Artillery Module: large missile weapons +20 OP and +1000 range. never_add, never_remove. 0 OP.
Unstable Artillery Module: large ballistic +10 OP, +1000 range, forced overload at flux level 0.8. never_add, never_remove. 0 OP.
Unstable Artillery Module: large energy +10 OP, +1000 range, overload at 0.8. never_add, never_remove. 0 OP.
Unstable Artillery Module: large missile +10 OP, +1000 range, overload at 0.8. never_add, never_remove. 0 OP.
Luddic Torch: death explosion radius x2.5 and damage x1.2; the ship loses 1/120 of max hull a second (75% in 90 s). never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Luddic Smite: the Torch plus no hull repair and speed up to x1.5, turn up to x2 as hull falls; same self-damage. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
The Otto Shield: shield unfold and turn x2 (not read by AO); shield forced on while not overloaded or venting. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Otto Phase Coils: dissipation 0, vent 0, overload x2, +300 OP per weapon, cloak forced on, +1% max flux a second until overload; all mounts must be empty. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
The Otto System: system cooldown x1/1.2 (read) and the system fires whenever ready. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Specialized Regenerative Hullmatrix (hidden, built in): crew x0; removes all d-mods on every ship creation.

Burn Drive Subsystem: Meteor: needs burndrive or kheburndrive, no shield, no phase cloak; drive makes the ship invulnerable with mass x13 and weapons off, then forced overload and flameout; cooldown x2. combat rows. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Burn Drive Subsystem: Phasediver: drive phases the ship (invulnerable, timeflow x15, weapons off), then overload. combat rows. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Burn Drive Subsystem: Red-Glare: drive reloads ammo weapons (10% of max a tick), weapons off, then overload and flameout. combat row. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.
Burn Drive Subsystem: Lightwave: drive top speed and acceleration x3, weapons off, then overload and flameout. combat row. never_add. 5/10/15/20 OP.

Morphogenic Lattice (built in on every Arondight form hull, hidden): reads the weave tags on the hull spec clone; charge_cell system uses +1, quick_cycle system cooldown x0.75 and regen +33%, zero_point_idle zero-flux speed boost down to 0.15 flux level, faraday_mesh EMP damage taken x0.5, dock_cycle CR recovery +100%, purge_valves vent rate +25%, lattice_sight sensor strength +25% and profile x0.75; these are in the stats. Combat nodes (munitions_loom, arm_actuators, watchdog_remotes, self_weave, afterimage, static_bleed, harvest_reflex, kinetic_buffer) run in a listener and AO does not see them. applyEffectsAfterShipCreation removes additional_crew_quarters and expanded_deck_crew from the variant. Cannot be added or removed.

Durendal Frame (built in on arondight_durendal): WardMechanics listener; while the Ward system is up all damage taken is multiplied by 0 and 50% of the blocked damage returns to the attacker as an energy EMP arc (range 1200). The ward never phases the ship (cancelPhasing). Cannot be added or removed.

Hauteclere Frame (built in on arondight_hauteclere): WardMechanics FLASH; ward active 0.5 s; a hit within the first 0.15 s reflects x2.0 and banks a cooldown reset, a late hit reflects x0.25 (arondight_ward_perfect_window 0.15, perfect_reflect 2.0, sloppy_reflect 0.25). Cannot be added or removed.

Joyeuse Frame (built in on arondight_joyeuse): WardMechanics BULWARK; 20% of blocked damage heals hull and 5% repairs armor (arondight_ward_heal_hull 0.2, heal_armor 0.05); the Bulwark system sets max speed x0.1 while up. Cannot be added or removed.

Longinus Frame (built in on arondight_longinus): WeaponBaseRangeModifier multiplies the base range of every non-decorative weapon by 3 (arondight_longinus_range_mult). AO does not see it. Cannot be added or removed.

Gae Bolg Frame (built in on arondight_gaebolg): damage dealt x3 (DamageDealtModifier, arondight_gaebolg_damage_mult), base range x2 (RangeDoubler), each weapon locks 3 s after it fires (the lock clears on a kill), ammo use x2 with half the weapon's damage dealt to the ship when ammo is short. AO does not see it. Cannot be added or removed.

Rhongomyniad Frame (built in on arondight_rhongomyniad): base range x2 (RangeDoubler); max speed x0.05 and acceleration x0.2 while the WS_ARM_R weapon fires (RhongomyniadAnchor). Cannot be added or removed.

Curtana Frame (built in on arondight_curtana): no code in the hullmod; the effect is in the arm beam (MercyEdgeBeamEffect): a ship whose hull the beam hits runs at 50% timeflow. Cannot be added or removed.

Clarent Frame (built in on arondight_clarent): while the arm beam freezes a target (timeflow 0.01, MercyEdgeBeamEffect) ClarentDrainPlugin sets vent rate x2, cuts weapon cooldowns 50%, and moves 15 hull a second from the target to the ship. Cannot be added or removed.

Fragarach Frame (built in on arondight_fragarach): no code in the hullmod; the arm weapon (FragarachPulseEffect) on each firing slows enemy ships within 800 to x0.65 timeflow and speeds allies to x1.35 for 4 s. Cannot be added or removed.
Reclaimer Attenuation (built in on the Reclaimer boss hulls, hiddenEverywhere): halves the damage the Reclaimer deals. Mission fleets only.

Energy Bolt Coherer override (built in on the wpnxt_mod_radiant skin only, hidden): WeaponBaseRangeModifier adds 200 base range to non-beam ENERGY and HYBRID weapons (no crewed penalty); on the radiant skin also acceleration x2, deceleration x1.5, turn acceleration x2, max turn rate x1.5. applyEffectsAfterShipCreation reads ship.getSystem().getId() with no null check, so adding it to a hull without a ship system throws. AO does not see the range. Never add.

Flogger Afterburner Visuals (A_S-F_superlasher, hidden): advanceInCombat sets hull, armor and EMP damage taken x(1 - 0.3 x effect level) while the ship system runs (DAMAGE_REDUCTION_SCALE 0.3). A_S-F_floggerBurn: 2 charges, regen 0.08 a second, 0.6 s in, 0.6 s active, 0.7 s out; about 11.5 full-effect seconds in 90 s, uptime 0.10 with 0.8 AI use, so damage taken x0.97. Under the 3% that earns a combat row.

Pirate Afterburner Visuals (A_S-F_dunnock_lp, A_S-F_gravesend_p, A_S-F_scrag, hidden): same script with DAMAGE_REDUCTION_SCALE 0.15. A_S-F_scragBurn: 2 charges, regen 0.05 a second, 1.0 s in, 0.3 s active, 0.6 s out; about 7.2 full-effect seconds in 90 s, uptime 0.064, so damage taken x0.99.

Flux Siphon (A_S-F_actuary, hidden): advanceInCombat, once a second, moves up to 600 x (1 - own flux level) soft flux from the ally within 1500 that has the most soft flux onto this ship. It stops while venting, overloaded or above 80% flux. The Actuary takes the flux, so its own flux rises by up to 600 a second while an ally has soft flux to give. AO sees none of it. Combat row VENT_FLAT -150: a quarter of the cap (judgment; ally soft flux and the 80% stop limit the inflow).

External Targeting Adjunct (A_S-F_istina, hidden): applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation, ballistic and energy weapon range +20%, non-beam and beam point defense range -15% (percent). AO reads the +20%. JAOShip reads only the flat part of the PD range bonus, so PD weapons score the full +20% where the game gives about +5%.

Enhanced Module Armor (MagicLib, hidden): advanceInCombat adds module death and hulk listeners and a raycast occlusion tag (pass_through_occlusion, deduct_first_hit_raycast with Vast Bulk). Station module hulls only. No stats.

Core Block System (armaa_altagrave_c_bp, armaa_altagrave_g_bp, armaa_altagrave_leftleg_ex; also the Altagrave and its leg modules): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation removes 3 shield hullmods (frontemitter, frontshield, adaptiveshields), 14 others (auxiliarythrusters, unstable_injector, ecm, nav_relay, operations_center, recovery_shuttles, additional_berthing, augmentedengines, auxiliary_fuel_tanks, efficiency_overhaul, expanded_cargo_holds, hiressensors, militarized_subsystems, surveying_equipment) and, for the player, converted_hangar, expanded_deck_crew and TSC_converted_hangar, only when the base hull id is armaa_altagrave_leftleg or armaa_altagrave_rightleg. The three listed hulls have other ids, so nothing runs there, and all carry no_autofit and module_unselectable. No removed_by row: it would bar those hullmods on the Altagrave, which carries the same hullmod.

Versatile Frame (armaa_leynos_frig, hidden): applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation reads the armaa_selector_* hullmods for slot C_ARML (4 weapons: armaa_leynosBoostKnuckle, armaa_leynos_ppc, armaa_leynos_railgun, armaa_leynosBazooka) and slot A_GUN (4 weapons: shotgun, aleste right arm, autocannon, crusher). With no selector present it takes the selector that matches the weapon in the slot, or a random one, adds that hullmod, clears the slot and adds the matching weapon. The slots are built-in mounts, so AO never fills them. never_add and never_remove rows for armaa_selector_* exist. Applies only to hull ids starting armaa_.

Versatile Frame (armaa_valkazard, hidden): applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation reads the armaa_selector_* hullmods for slot C_ARML (6 weapons), slot A_GUN (5) and slot B_TORSO (5; selector hullmods armaa_selector_blunderbuss, counter_shield, boson, chaos, ac20). With no selector present it takes the selector that matches the weapon in the slot, or a random one, adds that hullmod, clears the slot and adds the matching weapon. The slots are built-in mounts, so AO never fills them. never_add and never_remove rows for armaa_selector_* exist. Applies only to hull ids starting armaa_.

Versatile Frame (armaa_aleste_frig_classic, hidden): applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation reads the armaa_selector_* hullmods for slot C_ARML (5 weapons) and slot A_GUN (5). With no selector present it takes the selector that matches the weapon in the slot, or a random one, adds that hullmod, clears the slot and adds the matching weapon. The slots are built-in mounts, so AO never fills them. never_add and never_remove rows for armaa_selector_* exist. Applies only to hull ids starting armaa_.

Morgana POW UP (armaa_morgana, armaa_morganab_dummy, hidden): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation adds MorganaDamageListener on fighter-class ships (shield hits fill a GUARD bar: kinetic x2, HE x0.5, fragmentation x0.25, divided by max flux; the ship overloads for 10 s when it passes 100) and copies the weapons of module variant slot MORGANASUP into the fitted armaa_morganab wings. Fighter-class hulls with 2 fillable hardpoints; not scored.

Strikecraft(Frigate) (armaa_einhander, armaa_einhander_plus, armaa_valkazard, hidden; diable_strikecraft adds it to the Frostbite and Valkwanzer): an empty BaseHullMod used as a marker by cataphract.java (some hullmods stay when it is present) and armaa_takeOffScript. No stats.

No Venting (armaa_altagrave_c_bp, armaa_altagrave_g_bp, armaa_altagrave_leftleg_ex, hidden): advanceInCombat sets the AI flag DO_NOT_VENT (10 s) every frame, so the AI never vents. Not in the stats, so AO sees venting. Module hulls with no_autofit.
Infected Mothership (asm_legion_base, hidden): BaseHullMod marker that ThreatCompromised reads (MOTHERSHIP_MOD). No stats, no combat effect.
Aggressor (orr_aggressor_base, hidden): BaseHullMod marker; MissingWeapons reads it to choose the wreck variant (orr_wreck_*). No stats, no combat effect.
Aggressor (T) (asm_aggressor_base, hidden): BaseHullMod marker; MissingWeapons reads it to choose the wreck variant (orr_wreck_*). No stats, no combat effect.
Onslaught (T) (asm_onslaught_base, hidden): BaseHullMod marker; MissingWeapons reads it to choose the wreck variant (orr_wreck_*). No stats, no combat effect.
Onslaught (DPL) (orr_onslaught_dpl, hidden): BaseHullMod marker; MissingWeapons reads it to choose the wreck variant (orr_wreck_*). No stats, no combat effect.
Onslaught (orr_onslaught_base, hidden): BaseHullMod marker; MissingWeapons reads it to choose the wreck variant (orr_wreck_*). No stats, no combat effect.

Dweller Hullmod (shrouded_eye, shrouded_maelstrom, shrouded_maw, hidden): DwellerHullmodModded adds vice_dweller_boost as a perma mod to every non-fighter hull on each ship creation, then runs the vanilla Dweller hullmod. vice_dweller_boost rewrites weapon slots: Maw WS 013, WS 014, WS 019, WS 024 and Tendril WS 003 on every creation. skip_slots rows added for shrouded_maw and shrouded_tendril.

Dweller Boost (hidden, added by dweller_hullmod): with Luna setting vice_dwellerDifficulty (true), perma-adds vice_dweller_entropy_projector; Dwellers other than the Shrouded Eye get ballistic and energy range x1.2 (stats), missile range x1.2 on the Tendril, and time flow x1.15 (applyEffectsAfterShipCreation, not in the stats). Eye beams deal hard flux. Tendril: weapon groups cleared, WS 003 gets assaying_rift. Maw: groups cleared, WS 013 and WS 014 get pseudoparticle_jet, WS 019 and WS 024 get dwl_maw_scythe_silent. With the setting off the Tendril WS 003 is cleared and the Maw gets inimical_emanation (WS 013, WS 014) and assaying_rift (WS 019, WS 024). Combat row TIME 1.15 (the Eye gets none).

Dweller Entropy Projector (hidden): AdaptiveEntropyProjector under the Dweller id. Charge interval 7 s (Maelstrom 3.5 s), range 2000 (Maelstrom 2200), 2/2/3/4 pulses by hull size, each 300 energy and 400 EMP at the nearest enemy ship that is not Abyssal; shields block it. Dwellers chain a second arc to another enemy ship at 100%. Damage row: pulses / 7 x 1.7 (chain with a second target about 70% of the time, judgment) = 0.49;0.49;0.73;0.97 a second; the Maelstrom fires twice as often and the row cannot say so.
Auxiliary Refit (buffalo_ix_inf, hidden everywhere): applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation calls ColorSelectUtil.addOrRemovePlating, which adds or removes ix_metamorphic_plating by a setting. Cosmetic.

Hunter Killer Module (visible, installer): applies only with ix_semi_automated and ix_panoptic_command; applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation adds ix_hunter_killer_perm as a perma mod and removes itself. The never_add row for ix_hunter_killer exists.

Hunter Killer Module (hidden, Candor (IX) with ix_panoptic_command): with an ix_command_core captain, peak CR +100%, deployment points x0, recovery +1000, break chance x0; max CR -1% when the fleet has more modules than the limit. Removes itself without ix_panoptic_command. Hidden, so AO neither adds nor removes it.
Metamorphic Plating (hidden, tags no_build_in, no_drop): BaseHullMod that marks armor paint; ColorSelectUtil reads it. No stats.

Radiant (HG) Handler (hidden everywhere): sets the Panopticon core and Sword of the Fleet skill levels on the captain by hullmod presence; automated ships whose captain has ix_infomorph_vanguard get beam base range +200 up to a 900 cap (InfomorphVanguardRangeMod). Skill-gated; the never_add *_handler row covers it.
Standard Blue (hidden everywhere): BaseHullMod that PaintThisIXShipBlueButton and ColorSelectUtil read to set the armor color. No stats.
Manual Systems (RC9, hidden, hide_in_codex): ManualSystems sets the dynamic stat SHIP_CREW_SALARY_MULT x0.5 on the ship. Campaign crew salary only; no combat effect.

Temporal Phase Shell (roider_sheriff, hidden): phase cloak cooldown x0.2, flux level for minimum phase speed +50%, time flow while phased +50% (phase_time_mult), sensor profile x0.5 and supplies a month x2 on non-fighters (applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation); phases out when destroyed (DeadDiveScript). The design notes list phase cloak upkeep and cooldown as not scored, so the cooldown and phased time flow stay out of the score.

SotF Background Modifier (hidden, perma mod): with the Church of the Lifedrinker start flag it sets deployment points x(Luna sotf_cotlDPPenaltyPercent); removes itself from members outside the player fleet. Campaign start only.

Wisptender (sotf_wispmother, hidden): applyEffectsToFighterSpawnedByShip adds sotf_wispblossom to each wisp; when a wisp dies it spawns lwisp wings (hull size ordinal wisps). Fighter side, not scored.

Glanzwurf Swap (hidden): applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation, when no selector hullmod is present, calls setHullSpecAPI on the variant and the ship to the next hull in the cycle (tahlan_glanzwurf and tahlan_glanzwurf_b (selector hullmods tahlan_glanzwurf_selectorA, selectorB)) and adds that selector. The ship system and built-in weapons change with the hull spec. Hidden selectors, so AO never adds or removes them; AO scratch variants without a selector can flip the hull.

Stahlherz Swap (hidden): applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation, when no selector hullmod is present, calls setHullSpecAPI on the variant and the ship to the next hull in the cycle (tahlan_stahlherz and _b to _h (selector hullmods tahlan_stahlherz_selectorA to selectorH; _g also gets Flux Shunt as a perma mod, the others lose it)) and adds that selector. The ship system and built-in weapons change with the hull spec. Hidden selectors, so AO never adds or removes them; AO scratch variants without a selector can flip the hull.

Reality Glitch (tahlan_asria, tahlan_karma, tahlan_kelpia, tahlan_melusia, tahlan_rigveda, tahlan_samsara, hidden): when the ship takes more than 500 hull and armor damage in a frame or loses an armor cell, with the system off and not venting or overloaded, it phases for 0.5-2.5 s (1.5 mean; no collision, no system, no venting) then rests 10-30 s (20 mean); on exit all armor cells are set to the average, at least 40% of max. Share 1.5 / 21.5 = 0.07 of the fight with no damage taken (judgment: every cycle triggers). Combat row TAKEN_ALL 0 x 0.07.
Saveth Shield (tahlan_raven, tahlan_raven_phantom, hidden): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation sets the shield sprites. Cosmetic.

Scathach's Soul (tahlan_scathach, hidden): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation applies EMP taken x0.25, armor damage taken x0.75, turn rate and acceleration x1.25, time flow x1.1, ballistic and energy damage x1.2 and missile ammo x10, only when the fleet commander is Blackwatch or Legio. The player is neither, so nothing applies.
Creepy Spooky Stuff (tahlan_afflictor_dmn, tahlan_doom_dmn, tahlan_nxa, hidden): fog particles while phased. Cosmetic.

Vent Weapon Boost (tahlan_asria, tahlan_melusia, hidden): after a vent, ballistic and energy damage x(1 + min(2, 0.2 x seconds vented)) for 5 s (BOOST_PER_SECOND 0.2, BOOST_DURATION 5); the AI also vents by its own flux, hull and danger rule. A vent of 6.7 s (Asria: 0.6 x 20000 / (2 x 900)) gives x2.33. About 1.5 vents in 90 s: share 7.5 / 90 = 0.083 (judgment). Combat row DMG_BE 2.3 x 0.083 = +11%.

Volatile Dissipation (tahlan_rigveda, hidden): flux dissipation +200 x hard flux level (a flat bonus set in advanceInCombat, so the stats do not show it); above 75% flux an energy arc every 0.08-0.14 s at a random entity within 400 (destroyer; 350/400/450/500 by size), damage 20 x hard flux and EMP 40 x hard flux (destroyer); the AI vents by the Volatile Vents rule. Combat row VENT_FLAT 60 (hard flux level 0.3, judgment). Damage row 0.55 a second: 9 arcs a second x 0.15 of the fight above 75% flux x 0.4 landing on an enemy (judgment), damage at hard flux 0.5.

Volatile Vents (tahlan_karma, tahlan_samsara, hidden): while venting, an energy arc every 0.08-0.12 s from a system slot at a random ship, asteroid or missile within 400/500/600/700 (frigate to capital; allies included), 10/20/40/80 damage and 20/40/80/160 EMP. Damage row 0.5 a second: 10 arcs a second x 0.12 of the fight venting x 0.4 landing on an enemy (judgment).

Disposable Armor (uaf_neoyselif_romeo_armor, hidden): advanceInCombat detaches child modules below 25% hull; top speed and turn rate x(1 + 0.05 x detached modules). Module hull with no system. Not scored.

Increased Explosion (uaf_sekai_s, uaf_tsutsumu_l, uaf_wo_m, hidden): explosion_damage_mult and explosion_radius_mult x2.5 (tsutsumu_l), x2 (wo_m) and x1.25 (sekai_s). The script compares hull ids with ==, so the match depends on string identity and the multipliers can stay at 1. Death explosions are not scored.
Limited Ammo (uaf_wing_lynx, hidden): advanceInCombat orders a fighter back to its carrier when every ammo weapon is empty, and retreats it with the carrier. Fighter side; no wing row is needed.
No Explosion (uaf_neoyselif_romeo_armor, hidden): explosion damage and radius x0.01. Not scored.

Royal Arithmetic Control Configurator (uaf_ai_neuxoria, hidden): with uaf_light_wing_operation or uaf_super_heavy_wing_operation fitted, applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation toggles uaf_royal_arithmetic_sys_config_on and _off, clears slot NEUXORIA_DECO_COUNTER and adds the matching decorative weapon. The slot is not in the hull's fillable slots, so AO does not fill it. uaf_royal_arithmetic_config_selector removes a selector when neither wing operation hullmod is fitted.
Shield Manipulator (uaf_cherry_port_left, uaf_cherry_port_right, hidden): advanceInCombat forces the shield facing to hull facing +45 (left) or -45 (right). Module hulls.
Dimension Diver (uaf_super_nakiha_prototype, hidden): advanceInCombat ramps a shroud alpha from 0 to 225 while the system is active. Visual.

Dweller Hullmod (ost_shrouded_eye, ost_shrouded_maelstrom, ost_shrouded_maw, hidden): the vanilla Dweller creators run for the ost_ hulls (entities, rendering, strategy AI plugin). It does not add vice_dweller_boost, so no slot is rewritten.
Low Maintenance (yunru_koko, yunru_onslaught_xl, yunru_tiwaz, hidden everywhere): YunruBlank has no effect; the description says Zym's Low Maintenance overrides the id.
Engine Module (yunru_trikon_engine_central, yunru_trikon_engine_right, yunrupiratestarbaseengine, hidden everywhere): YunruBlank, no effect.
No Zero Flux Boost (Trikon engine modules, hidden everywhere): zero flux minimum flux level -2 and allow zero flux at any level x0. Engine modules without weapons; the boost is not scored.
Never Vent (yunru_dgun_battery, hidden everywhere): vent rate x0. JAOShip reads getVentRateMult <= 0 as noVent, so AO scores a ship that cannot vent.
Amaterasu Boss (zea_boss_amaterasu, hidden): shield damage taken x0.8 and flux capacity x1.25, only when the variant has the $zea_boss tag or the fleet memory has it. The hull has no_autofit.
Radiance (zea_boss_amaterasu, hidden): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation adds RadianceSubsystem (a MagicLib subsystem). Not read. The hull has no_autofit.

Corrupting Heart Boss (zea_boss_corruptingheart, hidden): with the boss tag, a phase-two listener (hull to 1, 8 s phased, hull 60% and armor 80% restored), shield damage taken x0.8 and flux capacity x1.5, and a drone buff on allies (ballistic damage +25%, energy rate of fire and flux cost -25%). Boss tag only.
Dawn Shield Style (zea_boss_nian, zea_dawn_ao, zea_dawn_bixi, hidden): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation sets the shield sprite to zea_shield_dawn. Cosmetic.
Dusk Shield Style (zea_boss_yukionna, zea_dusk_ayakashi, zea_dusk_funayurei, hidden): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation sets the shield sprite to zea_shield_dusk. Cosmetic.

Elysian Shield Style (zea_boss_amaterasu, zea_boss_corruptingheart, zea_edf_kiyohime, hidden): applyEffectsAfterShipCreation sets the shield sprite to zea_shield_elysia (zea_shield_elysia_2 with zea_conformal_shield). Cosmetic.
Serene Mist (zea_boss_nineveh, zea_boss_ninmah, zea_boss_yukionna, hidden): fog particles while phased. Cosmetic.

Yukionna Boss (zea_boss_yukionna, hidden): always adds BallLightningSubsystem; with the boss tag also a phase-two listener (hull to 1, 8 s phased, energy damage +50%) and BlizzardSubsystem. Subsystems are not read. The hull has no_autofit.
IFF Override (zea_edf_seiryu, hidden): adds IFFOverrideSubsystem (MagicLib subsystem). Not read.
Passive IFF Disruptor (zea_boss_corruptingheart, hidden): adds PassiveIFFDisruptorSubsystem (MagicLib subsystem). Not read.

Nian Boss (zea_boss_nian, hidden): always adds NianFlaresSubsystem; with the boss tag also an enraged listener at 50% hull (rate of fire x2, flux per shot x0.5, hull damage x0 for 5 s, min armor fraction +400% x missing hull share). Subsystem not read. The hull has no_autofit.

Ninaya Boss (zea_boss_ninaya, hidden): everything in applyEffectsAfterShipCreation sits behind the boss tag test (phase-two listener, escort spawns, phase AI script). Without the tag nothing runs. The hull has no_autofit.

Nineveh Boss (zea_boss_nineveh, hidden): everything in applyEffectsAfterShipCreation sits behind the boss tag test (phase-two listener, escort spawns, phase AI script). Without the tag nothing runs. The hull has no_autofit.

Ninmah Boss (zea_boss_ninmah, hidden): everything in applyEffectsAfterShipCreation sits behind the boss tag test (phase-two listener, escort spawns, phase AI script). Without the tag nothing runs. The hull has no_autofit.
Scorched Skies Doctrine (zea_dawn_ao, zea_dawn_bixi, zea_dawn_linggui, zea_edf_seiryu, hidden): AttainmentManager.applyEffectsBeforeShipCreation has its body commented out in 1.4.0. No effect.

Strikecraft Caller (diable_frostbite, diable_frostbiteP, diable_valkwanzer, hidden): with the armaa mod enabled it perma-adds strikeCraft and armaa_strikeCraftFrig and sets the hull spec travel drive to armaa_traveldrive after ship creation. removed_by,strikeCraft already exists.
Aquila Caller (diable_ashfallxivd, hidden): perma-adds eis_aquila only when timid_xiv is enabled; it is not. No effect.
Converted Hanger Bypass (diable_tornadop, hidden): sets Stats.FORCE_ALLOW_CONVERTED_HANGAR +1 so Converted Hangar can go on the Tornado (P). No other effect.

Wanzer Disruption (diableavionics_gust, diableavionics_miniGust, hidden): isApplicableToShip is false; applyEffectsAfterShipCreation attaches Diableavionics_assumeControlStats2 (a MagicLib subsystem, not decompiled). The repair-time debuff listener in the same file (repair time x2 for 10 s) is not attached by this method.
